lessons.name: minuet_in_g
lessons.title: Minuet in G (first half, simplified)
lessons.instructions: Three beats in a bar and one sharp in the key signature: every F is F sharp. The right hand starts in G position (thumb on G4) and stretches up in bars 3-4. The left hand plays a simple bass line.
tips: Count 1-2-3 with a gentle lean on beat 1.
Eighth-note runs must stay even: practise them slowly with the metronome.
Watch for the finger changes marked where the hand moves.
